game.name: Install Kodi
game.desc: Enables the Kodi section (Kodi 21 media center, bundled in the image - no download needed). Gamepad-ready, with the PM4K Plex client preinstalled: Direct Plays your library including HEVC, so your Plex server never transcodes (sign in with a plex.tv/link code, no on-device keyboard needed). Install any other addon from the official Kodi repository. EmulationStation restarts automatically after enabling. Exit Kodi from the power menu, a 2s hold on Back, or L1+START+SELECT.

game.name: Uninstall Kodi
game.desc: Hides the Kodi section by removing its launcher. The bundled media center stays in the image and your Kodi/Plex data under /storage/.kodi is kept. EmulationStation restarts automatically.
